# Mass

21 tools for Mass Entity configs and traits, spawners, entities, tags and signals.

Back to the [index](README.md).

## `add_mass_tag_to_entity`

*Additive.*

Add an FMassTag (a tag, not a trait or fragment, despite the name) to a Mass entity of the editor world (not PIE) by archetype migration. Caveat: EVERY entity sharing that archetype gets the tag, not only this one. Returns old_archetype_id, new_archetype_id and changed; inverse: remove_mass_tag_from_entity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_handle` | string | yes | Entity handle as "Index:SerialNumber", two integers such as "12:3" (no braces); a no-longer-valid entity is an error |
| `tag` | string | yes | Reflected name of an FMassTag struct without the F prefix, as list_mass_tag_types returns it (e.g. "MassOffLODTag"); /Script paths do not resolve |

**Returns:** `{ entity_handle, old_archetype_id, new_archetype_id, tag, changed }`

## `add_mass_trait`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Adds a trait (a concrete UMassEntityTraitBase subclass) to a UMassEntityConfigAsset and saves the config. Idempotent: if the config already holds a trait of exactly that class, itself or through its parent config chain, nothing is added or saved and the reply has added=false, already_existed=true and that trait's trait_path. trait_class takes a reflected name with or without its U prefix, or a /Script path; an unknown or non-trait class is an error, but an abstract one is not refused: the engine creates it behind an ensure and warns it is nulled out on save. Edit it with set_mass_trait_property; remove_mass_trait is the inverse; add_mass_tag_to_entity tags a live entity instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the UMassEntityConfig |
| `trait_class` | string | yes | Trait class name to add (e.g. UMassMovementTrait) |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, trait_class, trait_path, trait_count, added, already_existed, saved }`

## `create_mass_entity_config`

*Additive.*

Create a UMassEntityConfigAsset (an empty list of Mass traits) at package_path/config_name and save it; an existing config there is loaded and re-saved instead (created:false). Returns config_path, trait_count and saved. Add traits with add_mass_trait, then link it with set_mass_spawner_entity_types.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_name` | string | yes | Name of the UMassEntityConfig asset |
| `package_path` | string | no | Target content package path where the asset is created (default /Game/MCP) |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, config_name, trait_count, created, saved }`

## `delete_mass_entity`

*Destructive.*

Destroy a single Mass entity by its handle (Index:SerialNumber), or with all=true every Mass entity in the editor world (not a PIE world), archetype by archetype; no undo either way. Give exactly one of entity_handle and all. To despawn what one spawner made use despawn_mass_entities.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_handle` | string | no | "{Index}:{SerialNumber}" string returned by spawn/query. Provide this OR all. |
| `all` | boolean | no | Optional bool, default false: true destroys every entity of the editor world's entity manager instead of one. Provide this OR entity_handle. |

**Returns:** `{ entity_handle?: string, destroyed?: bool, already_destroyed?: bool, all?: bool, destroyed_count?: int, before_count?: int, after_count?: int }`

## `despawn_mass_entities`

*Destructive.*

Trigger entity despawning on a AMassSpawner (DoDespawning from the FTSTicker path, outside Mass processing); inverse of spawn_mass_entities. Reports the global Mass entity-count delta; no-op (was_empty) when this spawner spawned nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the AMassSpawner actor |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label, entity_count_before, entity_count_after, despawned, was_empty, note }`

## `fire_mass_signal`

*Destructive.*

Broadcast a signal to a single entity or to all entities (when entity_handle omitted). The tool does NOT validate the signal name — UMassSignalSubsystem::SignalEntity silently no-ops on unknown names, which is the documented engine behavior.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signal` | string | yes | Signal name (FName). |
| `entity_handle` | string | no | Optional. "{Index}:{SerialNumber}". If omitted, broadcasts to all live entities. |

**Returns:** `{ signal, dispatched_count: int, broadcast: bool }`

## `get_mass_config_parent`

*Read-only.*

Read the parent config path of a UMassEntityConfigAsset (inverse of set_mass_config_parent).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path of the UMassEntityConfigAsset |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, parent_config_path, has_parent, config_class }`

## `get_mass_entity_count`

*Read-only.*

Count entities matching a fragment/tag requirement. Requires "fragment" (UScriptStruct path or name) and optional "presence" ("All"|"Any"|"None" — default "All"). For tag-only queries use "tag" (UScriptStruct path).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fragment` | string | no | Script struct path or name (e.g. "/Script/MassMovement.MassMovementFragment" or "FMassMovementFragment"). |
| `tag` | string | no | Optional. Same format as fragment. Use to require an FMassTag marker. |
| `presence` | string | no | "All" (default), "Any", or "None". |

**Returns:** `{ matching_count: int, fragment, tag, presence }`

## `get_mass_entity_info`

*Read-only.*

Inspect one Mass entity of the editor world (not PIE) by handle, read-only: valid, built, archetype_id and the fragment types of its archetype. A destroyed or unknown handle returns valid:false rather than an error; a malformed handle is an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_handle` | string | yes | Entity handle as "Index:SerialNumber", two integers such as "12:3" (no braces) |

**Returns:** `{ entity_handle, valid, built, archetype_id, fragment_count, fragment_types: [string] }`

## `get_mass_spawner_info`

*Read-only.*

Read an AMassSpawner actor of the editor world, found by actor label (first match), read-only. Returns actor_name, count (the spawn count set_mass_spawner_count writes) and entity_types [{entity_config, proportion}] (what set_mass_spawner_entity_types writes) with entity_type_count; the entities it spawned are counted by list_mass_archetypes instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the AMassSpawner actor |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label, actor_name, count, entity_type_count, entity_types: [{ entity_config, proportion }] }`

## `get_mass_trait_property`

*Read-only.*

Read a property (name or dotted path) of a trait on a Mass entity config, picked by trait_class, as ExportText plus its C++ type. Use it because a trait is an instanced object inside the config that get_properties cannot address by class. Write: set_mass_trait_property.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the UMassEntityConfigAsset |
| `trait_class` | string | yes | Trait class name; the trait must be on the config |
| `property_name` | string | yes | Property name or dotted path |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, trait_class, property_name, value, type }`

## `list_mass_archetypes`

*Read-only.*

Census the Mass entities of the editor world (not a PIE world), read-only: every archetype with its live-entity and fragment counts. Returns archetype_count, total_entities (the sum over the archetypes), total (the entity manager's own count) and archetypes [{archetype_id, entity_count, fragment_count}]; get_mass_entity_info names the fragments of one entity, get_mass_entity_count counts by fragment or tag.

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ archetype_count: int, total_entities: int, total: int, archetypes: [{ archetype_id: string, entity_count: int, fragment_count: int }] }`

## `list_mass_tag_types`

*Read-only.*

Enumerate every UScriptStruct class derived from FMassTag (the zero-size tag markers — what BatchChangeTagsForEntities accepts). Filters out abstract and editor-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_abstract` | boolean | no | If true (default false), include abstract tags too. |

**Returns:** `{ count, traits: [{ name, path }] }`

## `list_mass_traits`

*Read-only.*

List the traits a UMassEntityConfigAsset holds itself (not those inherited from its parent config), read-only, in config order. Returns config_path, trait_count and traits [{class, name}]; edit them with add_mass_trait, remove_mass_trait and set_mass_trait_property.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the UMassEntityConfig |

**Returns:** `{ class, name, config_path, trait_count, traits }`

## `remove_mass_tag_from_entity`

*Destructive.*

Remove an FMassTag from a Mass entity of the editor world (not PIE) by archetype migration; inverse of add_mass_tag_to_entity. Caveat: the tag is removed from EVERY entity sharing that archetype, not only this one. Returns old_archetype_id, new_archetype_id and changed (false when nothing moved).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity_handle` | string | yes | Entity handle as "Index:SerialNumber", two integers such as "12:3" (no braces); a no-longer-valid entity is an error |
| `tag` | string | yes | Reflected name of the FMassTag struct to remove, without the F prefix, as list_mass_tag_types returns it (e.g. "MassOffLODTag"); /Script paths do not resolve |

**Returns:** `{ entity_handle, old_archetype_id, new_archetype_id, tag, changed }`

## `remove_mass_trait`

*Destructive.*

Remove a trait from a Mass entity config (inverse of add_mass_trait)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the UMassEntityConfig |
| `trait_index` | number | no | Index of the trait to remove (mutually exclusive with trait_class) |
| `trait_class` | string | no | Trait class name to remove; removes the first trait whose class is a child of it (mutually exclusive with trait_index) |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, removed, removed_trait_class, removed_index, trait_count, saved }`

## `set_mass_config_parent`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the parent (base) config of a UMassEntityConfigAsset for trait inheritance.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the child UMassEntityConfigAsset |
| `parent_config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the parent UMassEntityConfigAsset |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, parent_config_path, parent, set, saved }`

## `set_mass_spawner_count`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the spawn count on an AMassSpawner (reflection over its protected Count property).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the AMassSpawner |
| `count` | number | yes | New spawn count |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label, count, set }`

## `set_mass_spawner_entity_types`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Link Mass entity configs to a spawner's EntityTypes (written by reflection: the array is protected).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the AMassSpawner |
| `config_paths` | array | yes | Array of UMassEntityConfigAsset asset paths to set as the spawner's entity types |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label, entity_type_count, linked, set }`

## `set_mass_trait_property`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set one property (name or dotted struct path) of a trait on a Mass entity config asset from import text, as one undo step, and save it. set_properties needs the trait's object path; this finds it by trait_class (add it: add_mass_trait). The trait gets PostEditChange as after a Details-panel edit; there is no edit gate, and a value that does not import is refused with nothing changed. A failed save makes success false, with saved=false and save_error. Read: get_mass_trait_property.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Asset path to the UMassEntityConfigAsset |
| `trait_class` | string | yes | Trait class name; the trait must already be on the config (e.g. MassVelocityRandomizerTrait) |
| `property_name` | string | yes | Property name or dotted path (e.g. MaxSpeed, or Movement.HighResSpeed) |
| `value` | string | yes | String value parsed by FProperty::ImportText_Direct |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, trait_class, property_name, value, set, saved, save_error? }`

## `spawn_mass_entities`

*Additive.*

Run DoSpawning on an editor-world AMassSpawner found by actor_label and report the global Mass entity-count delta -- it spawns entities, not an actor (spawn_actor places the spawner). All configured types spawn at the spawner's own count (set_mass_spawner_count); a count that differs from it is an error and nothing is spawned. spawned can be 0. Inverse: despawn_mass_entities.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the AMassSpawner actor |
| `count` | number | no | Optional; must equal the spawner's own count (set_mass_spawner_count), which is what DoSpawning spawns. Any other value is an error and nothing is spawned. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label, entity_count_before, entity_count_after, spawned, spawner_count, note }`
